newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent falls on profit taking ahead of API.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent falls on profit taking ahead of API.

text.p: Brent crude futures were slightly lower in late trading on Tuesday amid profit taking ahead of the release of API data.
February Brent, which became the front-month crude on Monday, was last traded at $23.67 per barrel, down 13 cents from London's levels on Monday. Volume was just 75 lots.

Brokers said the market was well supported by worries over cold weather in the U.S. but they noted that profits were being taken ahead of the release of the latest stock data from the API after the close of New York pit trading later.
NYMEX January crude was last traded at $25.60 on ACCESS, down 14 cents from New York where it had jumped $1.27.
January heating oil, which led Monday's rally, was 0.27 cent lower on ACCESS at 74.55 cents per gallon after rising a dramatic 3.11 in New York.
